channel.title: Ayoola Morakinyo
channel.description: Founder of MDFLD. Machine learning and software engineer building computer vision for football boots and kit. Atlanta.

item.title: At 26, the Finish Line Looked Close
item.description: A friend I have had since I was twelve told me he is seriously ill. He is 26. In the same week I met a newborn at his start line, MDFLD posted for the first time in three months, and I renewed my outlook on time.

item.title: The Search That Should Have Been the Start
item.description: One evening I hunted a single pair of boots across eBay, Instagram, Depop, Facebook Marketplace and half a dozen boutique stores, knocking on every door but the right one. The anger that followed built the thing MDFLD should have started with almost two years ago, and it now indexes about thirty one thousand listings from our little server.

item.title: Large Visual Models Don't Exist Yet. I Want to Build Them.
item.description: What you could not do six months ago, you can do now. The world is using AI as a search box while it quietly became a build tool, and the thing I intend to build with it is the LLM equivalent for the visual world.

item.title: The Problem I Still Think Is Mine to Solve
item.description: Between two startups, the one whose problem I love most is the one I have left on the bench. Some honesty about why, and about the crossroads I am actually standing at.

item.title: Teaching an AI to write like you
item.description: Our agents drafted messages that sounded like an AI. The fix was not a better prompt or a fine-tune, it was noticing that every edit staff already made was free film we were throwing away. Shipped this week.

item.title: How I ship as a company of one
item.description: The system that lets one engineer ship for two companies: specs before code, tests before implementation, and AI agents that do the typing while I keep the thinking.

item.title: Starting this blog
item.description: Why I'm writing this and what to expect.
